parts.t: Jared Gibbons is a highly regarded South Surrey Realtor with expertise all over the Fraser Valley. Specializing in the vibrant communities of South Surrey, Langley, White Rock, Surrey, Ladner, and Tsawwassen, Jared brings a wealth of knowledge and a proven track record of success to his clients.

A REALTOR® since 2015, he specializes in residential and rural properties, including mobile homes, condos, townhomes, houses, farms, and land. Jared has more than $500 million in sales and has been in the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board Medallion Club for 10 straight years. He grew up on a farm in Langley and lives there again today, so he knows rural property from the ground up.
